headline: Mynt IPO Becomes Southeast Asia's Largest Offering in 2026, Raising Market Rank
summary: Mynt Inc.'s initial public offering emerged as Southeast Asia's largest IPO of the year. The transaction made the Philippines the third largest market in the region for capital raised, according to Deloitte.
why: Mynt (Globe Fintech Innovations) operates GCash, the leading financial technology and digital wallet platform in the Philippines.

impacts.name: Philippines
impacts.why: The Mynt IPO boosted the Philippines to Southeast Asia's third largest market by funds raised.
